name: openlane-ui
description: A monorepo for openlane UI apps and supporting libraries
author: openlane <info@theopenlane.io>

scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules/** && rm -rf ./apps/console/.next && rm -rf ./apps/console/node_modules && rm -rf ./apps/storybook/.next && rm -rf ./apps/storybook/node_modules &&  rm -rf ./packages/*/node_modules

resolutionsRationale.react: DEDUPE. 240+ transitive peer ranges span ^16..^19 and some still cap at ^18 (emblor, its nested @radix-ui/react-dialog, cmdk). Without the pin bun installs a second React and hooks throw "Invalid hook call". Bump in lockstep with react-dom, @types/react and @types/react-dom.
resolutionsRationale.react-dom: DEDUPE. Same reason as react — must move in lockstep with it.
resolutionsRationale.@types/react: DEDUPE. Two @types/react copies make cross-package JSX fail to typecheck ("JSX element type is not a constructor function"). Replaces the per-workspace "overrides" blocks in apps/console and packages/ui, which bun ignores outside the root manifest.
resolutionsRationale.@types/react-dom: DEDUPE. Same reason as @types/react — must move in lockstep with it.
resolutionsRationale.@radix-ui/react-label: LOCKSTEP with the radix-ui meta package (1.6.7 bundles exactly 2.1.15). A second Label copy loses the form-control context. Re-pin whenever radix-ui is bumped.
resolutionsRationale.@radix-ui/react-slot: DEDUPE. emblor’s nested @radix-ui/react-dialog still requests Slot 1.0.0/1.0.2; a second copy breaks asChild ref forwarding.
resolutionsRationale.@xmldom/xmldom: SECURITY FLOOR. mammoth requests ^0.8.6; the 0.8 line is unmaintained and carries the known XXE/parsing advisories. 0.9 is the patched line.
resolutionsRationale.fast-uri: SECURITY FLOOR. ajv requests ^3.0.1, whose URI parser carries a ReDoS advisory.
resolutionsRationale.form-data: SECURITY FLOOR. @types/request drags in form-data ^2.5.5, which generates boundaries with Math.random (GHSA-fjxv-7rqg-78g4).
resolutionsRationale.postcss: SECURITY FLOOR + DEDUPE. next pins postcss to exactly 8.5.23; the floor keeps every consumer on one patched 8.5.x.
resolutionsRationale.next: LOCKSTEP. next is declared in the root, apps/console and packages/ui; two copies break the server/client module graph. Update all four spots together.
resolutionsRationale.effect: FLOOR. uploadthing and @uploadthing/shared pin effect to exactly 3.17.7, older than what @uploadthing/react is actually built against. Forcing one current copy avoids a duplicated Effect runtime.
resolutionsRationale.esbuild: SECURITY FLOOR. tsup requests ^0.27.0, which carries the dev-server request-forwarding advisory (GHSA-67mh-4wv8-2f99).
resolutionsRationale.dompurify: DEFENSIVE FLOOR on an XSS sanitizer. Currently a no-op — the only transitive consumer requests "*" — kept so a future transitive pin cannot silently reintroduce a pre-3.2 copy.
resolutionsRationale.graphql: SINGLE COPY, load-bearing. graphql-request’s peer range still says "14 - 16" and graphql-config’s caps at 16, but two graphql copies make codegen die with "Duplicate graphql modules cannot be used at the same time". Never change this without running `task codegen:codegen` locally — CI does not run codegen, so a green check proves nothing.
resolutionsRationale.redux: DEDUPE across a major. dnd-core (react-dnd 16) requests ^4.2.0; react-dnd runs fine on redux 5’s legacy createStore, so one copy ships instead of two. Not security-driven — safe to drop if react-dnd ever breaks.
resolutionsRationale.sharp: SECURITY FLOOR. GHSA-rgj7-g3m4-5g8c (libheif heap overflow) affects <0.35.4. next requests ^0.35.3, which is not enough on its own.
resolutionsRationale.uuid: DEDUPE across majors. gaxios requests ^9.0.1 and teeny-request ^9.0.0; both only use the v4 named export, which is unchanged through v14.
resolutionsRationale.xmlbuilder2: FLOOR. @platejs/docx-io requests ^3.1.1, whose js-yaml dependency is the unmaintained 3.14 line. 4.x moves to js-yaml ^4.1.1, which is the line that still gets patches.
